messages:
Alex: hey all, alex here — first-week onboarding question. i pushed a branch and the Buildkite job fails at the step that publishes the docker image to GHCR with a 403/denied. not sure which token i should've used or who to ask for perms. any tips?

InfraBot: Buildkite failed: step `publish-image` (exit 1)
```
> Pushing to ghcr.io/redwood-inference/alex-playground:pr-12
> denied: requested access to the resource is denied
> error: failed to push some refs to 'ghcr.io/redwood-inference/alex-playground'
```

Alex: context: my pipeline has GHCR_PAT set as an env var in the project, generated from my personal settings. i gave it `repo` and `workflow` scopes when i created it during setup.

Rina: welcome! :wave: quick answer: GHCR requires package permission for pushes. `repo`/`workflow` alone won't cut it. you either need a PAT with `write:packages` and `read:packages` or to use the org GitHub App configured for packages.

Diego: addendum: if you're using the repo-level Buildkite pipeline secret, make sure the secret is visible to the pipeline and not masked or expired. we sometimes see folks create the PAT but forget to paste the new value into Buildkite. also double-check the env var name matches what's referenced in the step.

Alex: is there a quick local command i can run to validate the PAT scope before i rerun the build?

Rina: yep. locally run:
```
echo "$NEW_PAT" | docker login ghcr.io -u <your-github-username> --password-stdin
docker push ghcr.io/redwood-inference/alex-playground:canary-test
```
if the push gets `denied` then packages scope is missing. `gh auth status` can also show what the gh cli is authenticated as.

Alex: ran the docker login test and got `denied` too. looks like i forgot to include packages. i'll regen the token with `write:packages` and update the pipeline secret.

Priya: if you'd rather not create a PAT, ping me and i can ask platform to add the org GitHub App to the repo with packages permission (preferred for org-managed CI). i can also temporarily add you to the `ci-maintainers` team so you can test pushes.

Alex: thanks priya, i regen'd the token and replaced GHCR_PAT in the Buildkite project settings. re-triggered the build.

InfraBot: Buildkite started: build #218 8: step `publish-image`

InfraBot: Buildkite succeeded: build #218 8 8/29 steps passed9 - image pushed to ghcr.io/redwood-inference/alex-playground:pr-12

Alex: great, all green now. leaving a note in my onboarding doc about PAT scopes. thanks everyone! cc @Priya for the org-app walkthrough later. :smile:
